jobs.title: Face Deduplication Collection
jobs.description: The project compensation rate is $0.55 USD per accepted image. The objective of this project is to collect a large and diverse dataset of current neutral selfies, head-pose captures, and historical facial images to support machine-learning research and facial recognition model training at TELUS. The focus is on capturing real-world variation across lighting, poses, expressions, accessories, environments, and aging to improve model accuracy and robustness. The collection includes: • Current Neutral Selfies – clean frontal selfies serving as high-quality identity references, with natural variation in appearance and surroundings. • Current Head-Pose Captures – selfies captured in assigned head directions to introduce pose variation. • Historical Images – older photos from participants’ galleries to capture natural aging and long-term appearance changes. To qualify for payment, you must submit a minimum of 20 valid images. The maximum payout is based on 24 accepted images. Due to the strict automated and manual Quality Control (QC) process, we strongly recommend submitting 30 images to help ensure that enough images remain valid after review Note: Please use a Gmail address as your primary account when applying for this project. Creating a career you love? It’s Possible.</p> <p>At Pinterest, AI isn't just a feature, it's a powerful partner that augments our creativity and amplifies our impact, and we’re looking for candidates who are excited to be a part of that. jobs.title: Software Engineer II, Foundation
jobs.description: Platform Engineering at Chainalysis provides the shared infrastructure, tooling, and developer experience layer that powers every engineering team. We are moving away from team-owned infrastructure silos and consolidating onto shared, scalable platform patterns. The Foundation discipline owns the substrate: cloud infrastructure, networking, Kubernetes, streaming, and security primitives. Everything else runs on what we build. We are hiring a Software Engineer II to join the Foundation team. Your job is straightforward: build, improve, and operate the infrastructure primitives that every service at Chainalysis depends on — Kubernetes clusters, cloud networking, streaming infrastructure (Kafka / WarpStream), secrets management, IAM, and the reconcilers that make it all self-service and drift-free. This is an infrastructure-focused IC role at the C4 level, typically suited for someone with 3–5 years of experience. You will work alongside senior engineers who will pair with you, review your work, and invest in your growth. You will report to the Senior Manager of Platform Engineering. In this role, you'll: Build and maintain cloud infrastructure across AWS and GCP using Terraform — designing the modules and patterns that provision the substrate our services run on, and thinking beyond the immediate use case to how your work is consumed across the organization Operate and evolve multi-tenant Kubernetes clusters (EKS) serving the entire engineering organization — owning node lifecycle, upgrades, security contexts, and networking decisions that affect every team Own the operational side of our streaming infrastructure migration from managed Kafka (MSK) to WarpStream, building and maintaining the tooling that supports it Contribute to platform tooling and reconcilers that underpin our platform contract model — writing Go, working with the Kubernetes API, and building high-quality self-service primitives that engineering teams rely on to declare what their services need Design and maintain foundational networking and security infrastructure — transit gateways, GCP interconnect, ingress, security groups, IAM policies, and IRSA — getting the invisible plumbing right so nobody has to think about it Participate in on-call rotations and drive operational excellence — responding to infrastructure incidents, writing and improving runbooks, and feeding every incident pattern back into automation so the same class of issue never repeats We're looking for candidates who have: 3+ years of software engineering or infrastructure engineering experience Hands-on experience with AWS services (EC2, EKS, IAM, S3, VPC, or similar) — we're looking for people who have built and operated real infrastructure, not certifications Working knowledge of Kubernetes in production — you have operated or deployed workloads on K8s clusters beyond a local environment Experience with infrastructure-as-code (Terraform strongly preferred; Pulumi or CloudFormation acceptable) Proficiency in at least one of Go, Python, or shell scripting — Go is preferred because our reconciler work is in Go, but you should be ready to turn your hand to whatever the problem demands Comfort with CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions, Argo, Jenkins, or similar) and hands-on experience with on-call and incident response — you understand what it means to be accountable for production systems You might also have: Experience building Kubernetes operators or controllers — CRDs, reconcilers, and the controller-runtime library Familiarity with streaming infrastructure (Kafka, WarpStream, or similar event-driven systems) or depth in networking (VPCs, transit gateways, ingress controllers, DNS, load balancing, and security groups) Experience in regulated environments (SOC 2, ISO-27001, or similar compliance frameworks) or familiarity with GitOps patterns (ArgoCD, Flux) A passion for platform engineering as leverage — you care about making other engineers more productive, and when you see toil, your instinct

jobs.title: UKCSC Principal or Chartered Professional - Security Architecture
jobs.description: Intelance is an independent UK advisory and assurance firm and an IASME Certification Body for Cyber Essentials, Cyber Essentials Plus and IASME Cyber Assurance. We work with mid-market, enterprise and regulated organisations across cyber assurance, security architecture, governance and technology risk. We are appointing professionals who already hold formal UK Cyber Security Council (UKCSC) registration in Security Architecture at Principal or Chartered level, to join our associate panel and support the assessment and advisory of large, complex organisations. This is not permanent employment. Work is offered on a project-by-project basis according to client demand, suitability and availability. There is no guaranteed volume of work. Please note: current UKCSC registration in Security Architecture (Secure System Architecture and Design) at Principal or Chartered level is an essential requirement for this role. Applications without it will not be progressed. Tasks You may be asked to: Lead independent security architecture reviews and assurance for large, complex and regulated organisations. Assess cloud, hybrid and on-premises architectures across identity, networks, applications, platforms and data. Carry out threat modelling and identify credible attack paths, design weaknesses and control gaps. Judge whether proposed or alternative controls provide equivalent, proportionate protection. Review high-level and detailed designs and challenge unsupported assumptions. Advise boards, executives and technical teams on secure-by-design decisions and trade-offs. Produce clear, defensible, client-ready architecture findings and assurance reports. Complete scheme-specific training and participate in internal quality reviews where required. Requirements You must hold: Current UK Cyber Security Council (UKCSC) professional registration in Security Architecture (Secure System Architecture and Design) at Principal or Chartered level. This is mandatory and will be verified. You should also have: Substantial experience as a practising security architect in large, complex or regulated organisations. Strong command of secure-by-design principles, threat modelling and architecture assurance. Practical experience across cloud, hybrid infrastructure, identity, networks, applications and data security. Excellent written English and the ability to explain technical risk to non-technical decision-makers. SABSA, TOGAF, CISSP, CCSP and cloud certifications are welcome but do not replace the UKCSC registration requirement. You must be based in the UK, able to attend UK client sites when agreed, and able to contract through a limited company or another compliant arrangement. Benefits Senior, independent security architecture and assurance assignments. Flexible associate working based on your availability. Direct access to Intelance leadership. One example of a complex enterprise security architecture you personally designed or assured. Details of any relevant scheme, architecture or cyber-assurance qualifications. jobs.title: Lead Product Designer
jobs.description: Lead Product Designer - Cortex 📍 Manchester (Hybrid, up to 4 days WFH) 💰 Competitive salary, dependent on experience Street Group is one of the fastest-growing PropTech companies in the UK. We want to transform the experience of buying, selling, renting and letting property, elevating UK estate agencies through world-class technology. Cortex is an exciting new product that brings agentic AI into Street and Spectre, taking on the busywork so agents can focus on winning instructions and building relationships. It's early, moving fast, and will ultimately touch every part of the product suite. We're looking for a Lead Product Designer to shape what agentic UX looks like across all of it. We want someone who is genuinely excited by agentic AI, past needing to be told what's worth working on, and ready to help define a product category that doesn't have a playbook yet - working closely with senior stakeholders across the business. If you look at most UX job ads, you see a laundry list of requirements. We prefer to tell you how we actually operate so you can decide if this is the right environment for you. At Street Group, design is a strategic seat. You'll drive direction alongside product and engineering, not respond to them. Our users rely on us to run their businesses, so they love talking to us. You can spin up a call and validate a prototype instantly. We don't guess; we ask. We move at pace, including on strategic work. Strategy isn't a separate, slower track here - we test it by shipping. Here's what you can expect to be working on Shape the UX of agentic AI across Street and Spectre - deciding which agency workflows agents should own, then designing how that actually feels and builds trust for the user. Design across the whole suite, not one domain - valuation, prospecting, marketing, enquiry handling, sales progression, property management. You'll hold a huge amount of context. Define the patterns for a new category. There's no established playbook for agentic UX in property - you'll set it. Set the craft bar through your own output. The work you ship is the reference point for what good looks like. Prototype, test and ship at pace - getting working prototypes in front of real agents and iterating fast. You should apply if: You've built or shaped agentic AI, not just used AI tools - multi-step, tool-using agents you've designed, prototyped or shipped. You understand how they work and where they break. You've got a well-formed point of view on agentic UX - how you design for systems that don't always behave the same way, how you build in trust, transparency and control, and when to keep a human in the loop. You stay current. This field moves monthly and you keep on top of it. You're energised by an undefined problem space and bring the case for what's worth doing, rather than waiting for a brief. You're commercially fluent - you make design trade-offs informed by how the product performs, not just user preference. You define success before you ship and read the result after. You probably shouldn't apply if: Your AI experience is limited to speeding up your own workflow. This role is about designing AI into the product, and that gap will show quickly. You're looking for the next pay band up from Senior with broadly similar expectations. This is not a "Senior+" role - it expects materially more scope, autonomy and judgment. You need a well-defined problem before you can start. Cortex is still taking shape, and that won't change soon. You expect to be handed a roadmap. Here, you help write it. A bit about you AI & agentic depth: Non-negotiable, and the first thing we'll screen for. Current, hands-on knowledge of agentic AI, with real examples of what you've built or shaped. Craft: Lead-level UX and product design. Your work is exemplary and you can articulate it clearly enough to teach. Breadth: Comfortable operating across the whole product suite and holding a lot of context at once, not going deep on a single domain. Amb

jobs.title: Security Advocate | AI AppSec
jobs.description: About Escape Escape secures the code-to-cloud attack surface that covers DAST, ASM and AI Pentesting. Our platform continuously maps and tests every asset exposed to the internet, including undocumented APIs and endpoints, with automated AI penetration testing and DAST running at the pace of modern development teams. With a team of 45+ people based across Paris, Amsterdam, Hawaii, Boston, and New York, Escape is Series A funded and rapidly growing. We are building a world-class team to help organizations protect what matters most. The Role As a Security Advocate at Escape, you will bridge the gap between our security technology and the engineering community. You will champion security best practices, promote our platform, and empower developers, security teams, and customers to take proactive approaches to security. Our users and customers are deeply technical: Security Engineers, AppSec teams, developers, security researchers and CISOs. We’re looking for someone who can speak their language and become one of the technical voices of Escape in the security community. Your mission: demystify complex security issues, contribute to our product’s visibility, and build lasting relationships with technical communities. Through talks, live demos, content creation, and customer engagement, you’ll be the voice of Escape’s security expertise and a trusted partner for our users. Why We’re Hiring Some of the best conversations in cybersecurity don't start with a sales pitch. They start with an interesting vulnerability, a technical demo, a GitHub project, a conference talk, a strong opinion or a very good security meme. Key Responsibilities: Serve as a subject matter expert on application and cloud security, representing Escape at industry events, conferences, and webinars Create and deliver engaging content: blogs, videos, presentations, and technical documentation that educates and inspires Work directly with customers to understand their challenges, provide best practice guidance, and gather feedback for product improvement Build relationships with developer, security, and DevSecOps communities to amplify Escape’s message Stay informed on security threats, trends, and best practices, sharing insights internally and externally Partner with Product, Sales, and Engineering to ensure our solutions address real customer challenges What You Bring: Strong technical knowledge of cybersecurity, ideally AppSec, offensive security, penetration testing, web/API security or developer security. The ability to understand vulnerabilities and technical concepts deeply enough to explain and demonstrate them yourself. Excellent communication skills and the ability to make complex security topics clear, interesting and entertaining. Genuine interest in cybersecurity culture and the people behind it. Confidence engaging with highly technical audiences online and in person Curiosity and a strong research mindset. You naturally want to understand how things work and what can break. A willingness to create: writing, videos, demos, talks, live sessions or other technical content. Comfortable travelling regularly for conferences, meetups and community events. Excellent spoken and written English. What We Offer: Competitive salary and equity package Remote-first work with regular company offsites Opportunity to have a direct impact on our product and community A collaborative and inclusive team passionate about advancing security Hiring Process 30 min intro call with People & Talent. Technical/security conversation with the team. Practical case focused on security advocacy and content. Conversation with Growth and/or Security Research. 45 min conversation with the founders. jobs.title: Technical Lead, Machine Learning
jobs.description: About A1 There are over 5 billion users using basic applications today such email, notes, tasks that are not AI-native. Our mission is to build a proactive smart assistant for everyday users to bring intelligence to conversations, errands, organising and workflows, with minimal prompting. Our product focuses on achieving high reliability for long-running workflows, persistent context, and real-world task completion. The system must handle multi-step reasoning, interact with external tools, and remain reliable despite non-deterministic model behavior. Our objective is to help users complete tasks daily enjoyable with over ~90%* reduced time. Role As Technical Lead, Machine Learning, you own the execution layer of A1’s intelligence. You translate research direction into reliable, scalable, production-grade ML systems. This role sits at the intersection of research, infrastructure, and product. You are responsible for making models trainable, deployable, observable, and performant under real-world constraints. What You'll Do Own end-to-end ML system execution: data pipelines, training workflows, evaluation systems, inference architecture, and deployment. Fine-tune and adapt models using state-of-the-art methods such as LoRA, QLoRA, SFT, DPO, and distillation. Architect and operate scalable inference systems, balancing latency, cost, and reliability. Design and maintain data systems for high-quality synthetic and real-world training data. Implement evaluation pipelines covering performance, robustness, safety, and bias, in partnership with research leadership. Own production deployment, including GPU optimization, memory efficiency, latency reduction, and scaling policies. Collaborate closely with application engineering to integrate ML systems cleanly into backend, mobile, and desktop products. Make pragmatic trade-offs and ship improvements quickly, learning from real usage. Work under real production constraints: latency, cost, reliability, and safety Outcomes Research and models reliably translate into production-ready solutions with clear performance and quality targets. ML pipelines, training loops, and inference systems are stable, efficient, and maintainable. Production issues are detected, debugged, and resolved quickly, minimizing user impact. Team members are supported, aligned, and able to deliver high-impact ML work with minimal friction. Iterations on models and systems are measurable, safe, and improve user experience over time. Tech Stack Python PyTorch / JAX GPU-based training and inference system Ideal Experience You have built or shipped real ML systems used by people, not just demos. You are comfortable working with large models and understanding their failure modes. You write strong, production-grade code and care about system correctness. You are self-directed, pragmatic, and take full ownership of outcomes. You communicate clearly and collaborate well in small, high-trust teams. How We Work The best products today in the world were built by small, world class teams. We are a high talent density and hands-on team. We make decisions collectively, move at rapid speed, striking a balance between shipping high quality work and learning. Joining our team requires the ability to bring structure, exercise judgment, and execute independently. Our goal is to put in hands of our users a truly magical product Interview process If there appears to be a fit, we'll reach to schedule 3, but no more than 4 interviews. Applications are evaluated by our technical team members. Interviews will be conducted via virtual meetings and/or onsite. We value transparency and efficiency, so expect a prompt decision. If you've demonstrated the exceptional skills and mindset we're looking for, we'll extend an offer to join us. This isn't just a job offer; it's an invitation to be part of a team that's bringing AI to have practical benefits to billions globally. Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

Our product focuses on achieving high reliability for long-running workflows, persistent context, and real-world task completion. The system must handle multi-step reasoning, interact with external tools, and remain reliable despite non-deterministic model behavior. Our objective is to help users complete tasks daily enjoyable with over ~90%* reduced time. About the Role You will own the systems, processes and frameworks that drive performance across the company. You will lead company-wide OKR planning and review cycles, design scalable performance management processes, analyze organizational data, and ensure our culture and values are consistently reflected in how we hire, evaluate and develop people. You will work closely with leadership across the business to improve execution, increase accountability and help teams perform at their highest level. What You Will Be Doing Own and continuously improve the company's performance management framework. Lead company-wide OKR planning, tracking and quarterly review cycles. Design and implement scalable people processes that improve organizational effectiveness. Analyze people, performance and operational data to identify trends, measure outcomes and recommend improvements. Build dashboards and reports that provide meaningful insights into organizational performance. Define business requirements for HR systems, reporting tools and workflow automation. Partner with leaders across the company to improve team performance and execution. Develop frameworks for performance reviews, calibration, promotions and career development. Drive initiatives that strengthen accountability, ownership and a high-performance culture. Ensure company values are embedded throughout employee programs, performance evaluations and day-to-day operations. Continuously identify opportunities to simplify processes, eliminate inefficiencies and improve the employee experience. Support strategic people initiatives and organizational projects as the company grows. What You Will Need Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience. Experience in People Operations, People Analytics, Organizational Effectiveness, HR Strategy, Business Operations, Management Consulting or a related field. Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret data and translate insights into action. Experience designing or improving performance management frameworks, OKRs or organizational processes. Excellent problem-solving and structured thinking skills. Ability to write clear business requirements and improve operational workflows. Strong project management skills with the ability to manage multiple initiatives simultaneously. Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills. Comfortable working in a fast-paced, high-growth environment with evolving priorities. High ownership, attention to detail and a bias toward execution. How We Work The best products in the world are built by small, highly capable teams. We operate with high talent density, high ownership and high standards. We value people who can think independently, move quickly and solve problems without waiting for instructions. This is a hands-on environment. Everyone is expected to contribute directly to the company's success. Interview Process If there appears to be a fit, we will schedule up to 3 interviews. Applications are reviewed by members of our leadership and hiring teams. Interviews may be conducted virtually or onsite. We value speed, transparency and decisiveness throughout the process. jobs.title: Head of Compliance (UK)
jobs.description: About BJAK BJAK is Southeast Asia’s largest digital insurance platform, expanding financial access through automation, data, and digital scale. As we grow across markets, we are committed to building a platform that is safe, compliant, and trusted. We are hiring a Head of Compliance (UK) to lead regulatory strategy, risk governance, and compliance operations for our UK market entry and expansion alongside the CEO. This role is expected to hold the SMF16 (Compliance Oversight) Senior Management Function once approved, and will act as our primary point of contact with the FCA. This is a build role: you'll be creating frameworks, policies, and controls from scratch rather than inheriting an existing function. Why This Role Matters The Head of Compliance (UK) will: Design and enforce compliance frameworks that enable safe scaling of digital financial services. Ensure BJAK operates in accordance with UK regulatory standards, especially FCA requirements. Protect consumers through transparent, fair, and ethical practices. Establish BJAK as a trusted partner with regulators, partners, and industry stakeholders. Build compliance capability and culture across the company. What You Will Do Regulatory Leadership & Strategy Develop and maintain compliance frameworks aligned with UK regulatory requirements. Lead regulatory readiness for market entry, licensing, and ongoing supervision. Serve as the primary contact with the FCA and relevant UK bodies. Interpret regulatory changes and guide business strategy accordingly. Risk Governance & Compliance Operations Build policies and controls covering AML, KYC, data privacy, consumer duty, distribution, and claims-related compliance. Conduct risk assessments and implement remediation plans for identified gaps. Establish monitoring, testing, and reporting processes for ongoing compliance. Ensure internal audits, compliance reviews, and control testing are operationalised. Consumer Protection & Business Integrity Embed fairness, transparency, and responsible selling throughout the organisation. Oversee product compliance, marketing reviews, pricing governance, and distribution oversight. Implement complaint handling frameworks aligned with regulatory standards. Cross-Functional Support & Training Partner with product, operations, legal, marketing, and commercial teams to ensure compliant execution. Provide guidance on regulatory implications of new products, partnerships, or distribution models. Deliver training to ensure teams understand and execute compliance responsibilities. You Will Thrive in This Role If You See compliance as a strategic enabler, not a blocker. Operate with high integrity, sound judgment, and strong attention to detail. Communicate clearly and influence leaders using data and logic. Enjoy building frameworks and scaling systems from early-stage to mature environments. Thrive in fast-paced, evolving settings where regulation meets innovation. What You Bring 8+ years of compliance, risk, or regulatory experience within financial services, insurance, insurtech, or fintech. Deep understanding of UK regulatory frameworks, including FCA rules and consumer duty requirements. Experience in compliance for digital platforms, distribution, or insurance products (preferred). Proven ability to design policies, conduct risk assessments, and manage complex compliance programs. Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, including dealing with regulators. Bonus (Nice to Have) Experience in start-up or high-growth environments. Previous SMF experience. Background in insurtech, digital distribution, or online marketplaces. Knowledge of GDPR, AML, sanctions, or cross-border compliance. Location Requirement This role is based in the UK . This is a hybrid role. You are expected to work from our London office at least 3 days per week. Why Join Us Shape compliance for a fast-growing international fintech-insurtech platform. Spanning over 50 nationalities across 10+ global locations, our diverse cultures aren't a checklist; they are the competitive advantage driving our innovation. That means identifying where our broader payments and product suite solves problems customers haven't yet asked us to solve, and building the commercial motion to get those products adopted at scale. jobs.title: Cloud (Senior) Engineer / Architect (m/w/d)
jobs.description: DEINE AUFGABEN Du analysierst und konzipierst Lösungen für unsere Kunden hinsichtlich moderner Cloud Architekturen. Du entwickelst und betreibst passgenaue Lösungen sowohl in der Cloud als auch in hybriden Umgebungen und trägst mit deinen Kenntnissen und Ideen zur permanenten Weiterentwicklung und Verbesserung bei. Du analysierst bestehende Applikationslandschaften und konzipierst Lösungswege für deren Migration in die Cloud und setzt diese auch um. Du entwickelst gemeinsam mit dem Projektteam CI/CD-Pipelines und Microservices und sorgst durch den Einsatz von Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC) für Sicherheit, Stabilität und Compliance unserer IT-Infrastruktur. Du übernimmst eigenverantwortlich die Betreuung der Build-, Staging-, Deployment- und Release-Prozesse. Du bist in der Beratung unserer Kunden sowohl remote als auch vor Ort im Einsatz. DEIN PROFIL Du hast ein abgeschlossenes Studium der (Wirtschafts)Informatik oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation im IT-Bereich mit mindestens 3-5 Jahren Berufserfahrung. Du besitzt sehr gute Kenntnisse im Bereich Cloud Development & Architecture mit Microservices auf Basis von Kubernetes / OpenShift sowie Networking und Storage im Betrieb von Applikationen hybrid bzw. cloud native. Du bist im Bereich DevOps / GitOps / CI/CD mit Tools wie Github, Gitlab, CircleCI, Tekton etc. vertraut und Pipelines sind für dich nicht nur Leitungen zum Transport von Öl und Gas. Du bist im Bereich Bereich Software Engineering, Java/Kotlin sowie Quarkus, Spring Boot bzw. Micronaut zu Hause und Kafka steht bei dir nicht nur im Bücherregal.. Du hast auch Scriptsprachen, IaC und Automatisierungen wie zum Beispiel mit Ansible, Terraform, Linux/Bash und Python in deinen Projekten erfolgreich eingesetzt. Du gehst Themen mit hohem Qualitätsbewusstsein und einer starken Hands-On Mentalität an. Du hast Spaß and daran Technologien und Methodiken weiterzuentwickeln und Fortschritt ist dir wichtig. Du faszinierst dich für Digitale Trends, smarte Strategien und ihre Wechselwirkungen. Du kommunizierst klar, präsentierst souverän und hast keine Scheu vor Publikum. Deutsch und Englisch? Kein Problem – du fühlst dich in beiden Sprachen wohl, schriftlich wie mündlich (mind. C1-Niveau in beiden Sprachen). Du bist reisebereit. Du arbeitest gern im Team, denn gemeinsam erreichen wir mehr. Du übernimmst dabei gerne Verantwortung, bringst Eigeninitiative mit und packst motiviert mit an. DEINE BENEFITS Unterstützende Teamkultur: Teamzusammenhalt ist uns wichtig - wir unterstützen uns gegenseitig und pflegen eine gesunde Officekultur. Unser Eventteam plant regelmäßige Afterworks und sorgt für einen Austausch außerhalb des Arbeitsplatzes. Schnelle Verantwortungsübernahme: Du übernimmst ab Tag 1 spannende Aufgaben mit eigener Verantwortung - egal ob auf deinem Projekt oder bei der Einbringung in interne Aufgabe - du gestaltest mit! Head of Privacy Perk is the intelligent platform for travel and spend - bringing travel bookings, events, expense management, and invoice payments together in one AI-powered platform. We serve thousands of businesses globally, from high-growth start-ups to major enterprises, and we’re backed by world-class investors. jobs.title: Finance Engineer (m/f/d)
jobs.description: 🎤 Why voize? Because we’re more than just a job! At voize, we believe the greatest gift to frontline workers is time - time to care, connect, and be present. Today, that time is lost to busywork and complex systems that pull them away from what matters most: people . Our vision is to change that by building AI companions that seamlessly take over digital workflows. We don’t replace humans with technology - we amplify their impact. Our mission is backed with a $50M Series A funding led by Balderton Capital, with support from HV Capital, Y Combinator and other leading VCs. Today, 2,000+ facilities trust voize, and over 200,000 users rely on our AI companion to ease their daily workload. As a dynamic team, we combine first-in-class technology with meaningful social impact. And now, we’re looking for you to join us on this mission! 💡 Your Mission: Build the financial engine for our next stage of growth As a Finance Engineer , you will play a key role in building and scaling our Finance function as voize continues to grow internationally. This is a broad, high-ownership role combining FP&A, business partnering, accounting, finance operations, and finance engineering . You will own important financial processes from budgeting and forecasting to management reporting and preparatory accounting, while working closely with teams across the business to turn financial data into better decisions. At the same time, you'll build a modern, technology-enabled Finance function . You'll connect systems, improve data flows, automate repetitive processes, and leverage AI wherever it can make Finance more efficient and scalable. As we expand internationally, you'll also gain exposure to multiple entities, local GAAPs, and different accounting requirements. We're looking for someone who enjoys both the numbers and the systems behind them — someone who doesn't just run finance processes, but constantly asks how we can build them better. 🚀 Your Daily Business - No two days are alike Support budgeting, forecasting, and financial planning , providing clear insights into business performance, risks, and opportunities, and act as a finance business partner to teams across voize. Drive financial reporting and analysis , building models, dashboards, and decision-support tools that help leadership and teams understand performance and make better decisions. Own and improve operational finance processes , including preparatory accounting, invoice and expense workflows, reconciliations, payment processes, and month-end preparation. Build and improve our Finance stack , connecting systems and data, automating recurring processes, and using tools such as Spendesk, ERP/accounting systems, BI tools, and AI to reduce manual work. Support our international growth , working with external accounting partners across countries and gaining exposure to different GAAPs, statutory requirements, and international finance operations. 🤝 Your Skillset - What you bring to the table 4 - 7 years of hands-on experience in Finance, FP&A, Controlling, Accounting, or a similar role , with solid accounting knowledge and practical bookkeeping experience. Strong analytical and commercial thinking , with the ability to understand financial drivers, challenge assumptions, and turn numbers into clear recommendations. A strong systems mindset: you enjoy understanding how finance processes, systems, and data fit together and naturally look for ways to make them simpler, more reliable, and scalable. Strong AI & automation capabilities: Hands-on experience using AI and automation to redesign and improve Finance workflows, not just as productivity tools, but to automate repetitive work, improve analysis, and build more scalable processes. Able to identify high-impact use cases and implement practical solutions independently. Modern finance systems & tools: Hands-on experience working with ERP/accounting systems and modern Finance tools. Experience with Spendesk, BI/reporting tools

jobs.title: Head of Product (f/m/d)
jobs.description: OUR PURPOSE AT PLANCRAFT Building the backbone of European trades together – with AI-first software. We’re not just building software – we’re on a mission to create space for contractors & tradespeople by equipping them with AI solutions that work the way they do: fast, practical, and AI-first. With Tier 1 Investors from Europe and the US, like Headline and Creandum as well as 30,000+ tradespeople as customer base, we’re scaling across Europe to turn scattered tradespeople into thriving communities. We believe in zero admin, not zero personality – and we build every feature with the people in mind who wear the boots, not the suits. We’re #stoked to shape the future, #together as a team, and #humble in our mission to support the builders of tomorrow. YOUR MISSION AT PLANCRAFT As our Head of Product (f/m/d) , you'll shape what an AI-first product for the trades can become — and turn that ambition into products used by tradespeople across Europe. We're moving beyond software that digitises administrative work towards software that increasingly does the work itself: answering calls a busy shop can't get to, turning information from the job site into quotes, keeping invoicing moving, and helping business owners understand where their attention is needed. The challenge is to make these capabilities part of one coherent product experience — not simply add AI features to an existing product. The playbook for software that runs a trades business for its owner doesn't exist yet. You'll play a key role in shaping it. And the timing matters: we already have a substantial customer base, we're expanding into new European markets, and we're heading into our next stage of growth. AI is fundamentally changing what's possible for our customers, while our existing scale means the decisions you make can reach real businesses quickly. You'll lead our Product Management and UX teams and turn company strategy into focused product execution. You'll define where AI meaningfully changes the customer experience, drive priorities and trade-offs across our core product, AI capabilities, and European markets, and set the bar for products customers can trust even when the underlying technology is probabilistic. At the same time, you'll shape how Product works at plancraft: developing a strong Product and UX organisation, bringing teams closer to customers and outcomes, and creating the clarity and ownership needed to move fast. Your Responsibilities Make AI the product, not a feature. Define where AI can fundamentally change how tradespeople run their businesses and translate those opportunities into coherent product experiences across our platform. Set the bar for trustworthy AI products. Own how we approach AI quality, reliability, evaluation, and decision boundaries — ensuring customers can confidently rely on the capabilities we put into their hands. Turn strategy into focus. Translate company strategy into a prioritised product portfolio and clear team outcomes, driving prioritisation and trade-off decisions across markets, platform, and AI. Lead Product Management and UX as one function. Directly lead around nine PMs and designers, raise the bar on product thinking, develop their capabilities, and strengthen ownership across the organisation. Build outcome-oriented product teams. Continue the shift from domains and output towards teams that own customer problems and outcomes, stay close to real tradespeople through discovery, data, and experimentation, and have the autonomy to act on what they learn. Build for Europe. Scale the product across markets, balancing shared foundations with the customer and market needs that genuinely differ. Create a product organisation that moves with clarity. Establish a pragmatic operating model, clear decision-making rhythms, and strong interfaces across Product, Engineering, Design, and GTM — with product and customer outcomes as the measure of success and commercial outcomes co-owned with GTM. jobs.title: VP Sales (f/m/d)
jobs.description: At remberg, you’ll help to keep the world running. Everything that gets produced relies on a maintenance team behind the scenes that keeps the machines, equipment and infrastructure running. We are helping these teams by simplifying their work with modern, agentic maintenance software. At remberg, we are serving clients like Remondis, Würth, Edeka, Rotkäppchen and 300+ more. Supported by the visionary founders of category-defining businesses such as Celonis, Dash0, UiPath, Personio and Forto, as well as leading investors like Earlybird, Speedinvest, Oxx, Acton, and Fly Ventures, remberg is positioned to be the European category leader for modern, agentic maintenance software. WHAT THIS ROLE OFFERS As VP Sales (f/m/d), you own the entire sales function including upselling. You report to the CEO, sit on the leadership team alongside our co-founders and functional leads, and own the sales number at board level together with the CEO. You lead a total sales head count of 13 - 15 people (BDRs, AEs, Team Lead / Head of). Your mandate is execution excellence and taking the organization to its next level. You lead across two go-to-market priorities: Prio 1 your primary lever: high-touch Enterprise sales to industrial companies Prio 2: a lean, low-touch motion for smaller accounts that you lead commercially The role is office-based in Munich (min. 3, ideally 4 days a week). THE IMPACT YOU'LL HAVE Sales strategy & market focus: Fully own the long-term sales strategy on a 2+ year horizon: identify and double down on the right markets and verticals, drive ICP shifts, and decide where remberg plays and wins, consistently aligned with remberg's overall direction. Sparring partner to the C-level: Act as a sparring partner to the CEO and co-founders in defining remberg's path, bringing in deep domain expertise and market perspective. Leadership team & org design: Build and steer a high-performing sales leadership team (Head of, Team Leads BDR and AEs), make key hiring and succession decisions, and own portfolio and investment decisions within Sales: org design, budget, and priorities. Enterprise sales (Prio 1): Own new + expansion ARR from Enterprise accounts. Drive complex, multi-stakeholder deals with maintenance, operations, and IT buyers, and bring rigor to qualification and forecasting (MEDDPICC). Pipeline generation: Own pipeline coverage end to end. Steer the BDR team across outbound, inbound, events, and partners, and continuously sharpen ICP targeting, messaging, and playbooks. SAP ecosystem, partnerships & solution engineering: Build and grow remberg's presence in and around the SAP ecosystem: partners, system integrators, and consultancies. Position integrations as a differentiator in Enterprise deals and build up solution engineering (integration scoping, technical validation, proof-of-concepts) in close partnership with Product and Engineering. Forecast & board reporting: Own the forecast and sales KPIs, translate signals into action, and report revenue performance together with the CEO at board level. Low-touch GTM (Prio 2): Lead the lean, low-touch motion for smaller accounts commercially, including expansion in tight alignment with Customer Success. Use automation and AI where they create leverage. HOW YOU'LL GROW WITH US Must-haves: Sales leadership with an Enterprise track record: 10+ years leading AE and/or BDR teams in B2B SaaS, with a proven Enterprise new-logo track record, strong coaching skills, and a passion for people development. Comfortable owning the number and driving results under pressure. Outbound-led pipeline building: You have built an outbound-led pipeline motion yourself and demonstrably live MEDDPICC or a comparable qualification framework, from first touch to procurement and legal. Stage fit: You have scaled a sales organization in the 10-20 M€ ARR range and know what to build, and what breaks, at this stage. Languages: Business-fluent German and proficient English Nice-to-haves: Industria

jobs.title: Software Architect (m/f/d)

We are industry pioneers who are ambitious, bold, and visionary. We push limits, think outside-the-box and strive for technological excellence to shape the future of aerial data. Company Shuttle: Enjoy our convenient shuttle service that picks you up from Pasing in Munich and brings you to our location, with return trips at the end of the workday. About us: Quantum Systems specialises in the development, design, and production of small Unmanned Aerial Systems (sUAS). The company’s range of electric vertical take-off and landing (eVTOL) sUAS are built to maximize range and versatility and to provide operators with a seamless user experience. By integrating cutting-edge software capabilities, like edge computing and real-time AI-powered data processing, Quantum Systems is building next-generation UAS for clients in defence, security, public sectors. Our commitment: We are an open-minded company that not only values diversity, but actively promotes it.

jobs.title: QA Engineer
jobs.description: About ScholarshipOwl ScholarshipOwl is the largest scholarship marketplace in the US, using AI to connect 14 million students who are looking for scholarships with companies that are looking for students. Our mission is to make education financing more accessible and engaging, while giving brands a way to connect with the next generation. We’re powered by AI technology that simplifies scholarship discovery, streamlines the application process, and delivers measurable results for both students and partners. Whether it’s helping students secure funding or enabling brands to run impactful campaigns, we’re reshaping how education is funded — and discovered. The Role We’re looking for a highly skilled and innovative QA Engineer to lead end-to-end quality assurance, test automation, and release verification across our web platforms and supporting microservices. You’ll play a pivotal role in ensuring zero-regression web releases, fast user conversion funnel performance, and seamless multi-service integrations for millions of students. In this role, you will champion the "new generation" of quality engineering. Beyond traditional test automation, you will leverage modern AI coding assistants (such as Cursor, Copilot, ChatGPT, Claude, and Gemini) as your primary force multiplier to achieve maximum test coverage at unmatched speed. Working closely with frontend and backend teams across a modern multi-service architecture, you will shift quality left, auditing Figma specs before sprint commitments, reviewing PRs, and maintaining continuous quality gates in our CI/CD pipelines. What You’ll Do End-to-End Web Automation: Build, maintain, and execute parallelized E2E smoke and regression test suites using Playwright and TypeScript, integrated directly into GitLab CI pipelines. API & Contract QA: Establish automated schema and contract test coverage across our platform, guaranteeing zero breaking changes for web users. AI Integration: Deeply integrate AI tools (Cursor, Copilot, ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini) into daily workflows to generate Playwright scripts directly from Figma specs, synthesize complex mock payloads, and automate log triage to double QA efficiency. Shift-Left Quality Champion: Audit Figma design specs, UX flows, and API contracts early to catch edge cases, logic gaps, and design flaws before sprint commitments and development begin. Participate actively in PR reviews. System Observability & Triage: Monitor build health, Sentry error logs, GCP Cloud Run logs, and Network profiling tools to isolate bugs rapidly between Nuxt frontend state, GraphQL resolvers, and Laravel backend MySQL databases. Asynchronous Integration Verification: Validate complex messaging and outreach workflows. jobs.title: Finance Engineer (m/f/d)
jobs.description: 🎤 Why voize? Because we’re more than just a job! At voize, we believe the greatest gift to frontline workers is time - time to care, connect, and be present. Today, that time is lost to busywork and complex systems that pull them away from what matters most: people . Our vision is to change that by building AI companions that seamlessly take over digital workflows. We don’t replace humans with technology - we amplify their impact. Our mission is backed with a $50M Series A funding led by Balderton Capital, with support from HV Capital, Y Combinator and other leading VCs. Today, 2,000+ facilities trust voize, and over 200,000 users rely on our AI companion to ease their daily workload. As a dynamic team, we combine first-in-class technology with meaningful social impact. And now, we’re looking for you to join us on this mission! 💡 Your Mission: Build the financial engine for our next stage of growth As a Finance Engineer , you will play a key role in building and scaling our Finance function as voize continues to grow internationally. This is a broad, high-ownership role combining FP&A, business partnering, accounting, finance operations, and finance engineering . You will own important financial processes from budgeting and forecasting to management reporting and preparatory accounting, while working closely with teams across the business to turn financial data into better decisions. At the same time, you'll build a modern, technology-enabled Finance function . You'll connect systems, improve data flows, automate repetitive processes, and leverage AI wherever it can make Finance more efficient and scalable. As we expand internationally, you'll also gain exposure to multiple entities, local GAAPs, and different accounting requirements. We're looking for someone who enjoys both the numbers and the systems behind them — someone who doesn't just run finance processes, but constantly asks how we can build them better. 🚀 Your Daily Business - No two days are alike Support budgeting, forecasting, and financial planning , providing clear insights into business performance, risks, and opportunities, and act as a finance business partner to teams across voize. Drive financial reporting and analysis , building models, dashboards, and decision-support tools that help leadership and teams understand performance and make better decisions. Own and improve operational finance processes , including preparatory accounting, invoice and expense workflows, reconciliations, payment processes, and month-end preparation. Build and improve our Finance stack , connecting systems and data, automating recurring processes, and using tools such as Spendesk, ERP/accounting systems, BI tools, and AI to reduce manual work. Support our international growth , working with external accounting partners across countries and gaining exposure to different GAAPs, statutory requirements, and international finance operations. 🤝 Your Skillset - What you bring to the table 4 - 7 years of hands-on experience in Finance, FP&A, Controlling, Accounting, or a similar role , with solid accounting knowledge and practical bookkeeping experience. Strong analytical and commercial thinking , with the ability to understand financial drivers, challenge assumptions, and turn numbers into clear recommendations. A strong systems mindset: you enjoy understanding how finance processes, systems, and data fit together and naturally look for ways to make them simpler, more reliable, and scalable. Strong AI & automation capabilities: Hands-on experience using AI and automation to redesign and improve Finance workflows, not just as productivity tools, but to automate repetitive work, improve analysis, and build more scalable processes. Able to identify high-impact use cases and implement practical solutions independently. Modern finance systems & tools: Hands-on experience working with ERP/accounting systems and modern Finance tools. Experience with Spendesk, BI/reporting tools

jobs.title: Senior Ruby Backend Engineer with affinity for observability (d/w/m)

Our online platform helps customers from calculating their affordability to getting matched to relevant properties to calculating and processing the optimal mortgage. Our advisor-facing products include a fully-fledged back-office that ensures customer interactions over email, chat, and telephone — as well as the processing and handling of mortgage applications and financial documents — are reliable, efficient, and secure. You'll help ensure our calculation engines, back-office tools, and customer-facing platform become more resilient and secure as we grow. This one asks you to build them, inside the part of the business where cybersecurity actually happens, with managers who are still learning to lead and specialists who know exactly how rare they are. It's your chance to embed yourself in a growing German operation, build real infrastructure, and leave behind something that sticks all while knowing exactly what the timeline is. About Eye Security Eye Security protects European mid-market businesses from cyber threats: 24/7 monitoring and response, incident response, and integrated cyber insurance, all in one. We're 170+ people across the Netherlands, UK, Germany and Belgium, with roots in Dutch intelligence and national CERTs. Our mission is simple: enterprise-grade security shouldn't only be for enterprises. We've just closed Series C and are scaling fast. Germany is a growth market for us, and we need local People leadership to match that ambition. The Role You'll be the People Business Partner for our German operations, partnering with sales teams, customer support & on boarding, and project management. jobs.title: Founding Customer Support Engineer
jobs.description: The mission: comstruct is building the agentic workforce for European construction. Our agents turn paper delivery notes, fragmented invoices and offline supplier decisions into structured, real-time data and live decisions, embedded inside the largest contractors in Europe and the US. To accelerate this journey, we secured a €12.5M seed financing round from 20VC and Google Ventures , along with top European investors. comstruct builds AI agents for construction. Our platform automates the entire flow from the bill of quantities to the fully verified invoice: RFQs and supplier matching, bid comparison and negotiation, framework contracts and orders, digital delivery notes, invoice verification and sustainability reporting. We're looking for exceptional talent to help us bring this to an industry that still runs most of it by hand. About the role 🦺 As our Founding Customer Support Engineer you own what happens after go-live: you keep our customers' integrations running and their teams using comstruct every day. When a delivery note doesn't map to the right project, a 3-way match fails, or data stops flowing from a customer's SAP, you own the problem end to end. You dig into logs, APIs, and data flows to find the root cause, prepare and ship smaller pull requests yourself, and work closely with engineering on more complex fixes. When you're not deep in a technical problem, you're on calls with customers, making sure the teams that went live keep using comstruct in their daily work. You're the person the customer calls when something breaks and the one who makes sure it doesn't break again. Inside comstruct you're the voice of the customer: you spot the feature gaps that surface in real use and prioritize with the Product Engineering team which ones get built. The deeper you get into how the product works and where it falls short, the more the door opens to move into a Forward Deployed Engineer or Product Engineering role and ship those fixes and features yourself. What you will be building 🏗️ Own inquiries end-to-end: Our customers run some of the largest construction sites in Europe. When something breaks, it's real: trucks, deliveries, invoices, deadlines. Automate support with our own agents: We sell AI agents; support is a function where we also deploy them internally. You'll work out which parts of the flow an agent can handle and where the human touch still wins. Ship the fix when it's yours to ship: Small PRs, config and mapping changes, data repair scripts, clearer error handling. Reviewed by engineering, shipped by you. Kill recurring issues: Every ticket is a data point. You spot the patterns, bring them to Product Engineering with evidence, and push for the change that makes that ticket class disappear. Build the support foundation: Playbook, macros, help center, internal runbooks. You won't inherit a finished system. You'll write the first version of it as you learn, with the founders and engineering behind you. Report what matters: Time to first response, time to resolution on integration breaks, and how many recurring issue classes you eliminated. You consistently share where we stand with Customer Value Engineers and the wider team. What we’re looking for ✨ 1 - 2 years in a technical, customer-facing role: Customer Success or Support Engineer, Solution Engineer, Implementation, TAM or similar. You're comfortable in APIs, logs, SQL and data flows and can debug across systems you didn't build. You know when an issue is the integration, the data or the product. You can explain a failed integration to an engineer and to a non-technical customer stakeholder, and both walk away clear. You want to understand how the product works under the hood instead of treating it as a black box. You are willing to work five days a week from our Munich office with occasional customer travel. You are native in German and fluent in English . Nice to have: Ideally, you have initial experience with Construction Tech, Supply Chain or Logis

jobs.description: About Phaidra Phaidra is building the future of industrial automation. The world today is filled with static, monolithic infrastructure. Factories, power plants, buildings, etc. operate the same they've operated for decades — because the controls programming is hard-coded. Thousands of lines of rules and heuristics that define how the machines interact with each other. The result of all this hard-coding is that facilities are frozen in time, unable to adapt to their environment while their performance slowly degrades. Phaidra creates AI-powered control systems for the industrial sector, enabling industrial facilities to automatically learn and improve over time. Specifically: We use reinforcement learning algorithms to provide this intelligence, converting raw sensor data into high-value actions and decisions. We focus on industrial applications, which tend to be well-sensorized with measurable KPIs — perfect for reinforcement learning. We enable domain experts (our users) to configure the AI control systems (i.e. agents) without writing code. They define what they want their AI agents to do, and we do it for them. Our team has a track record of applying AI to some of the toughest problems. From achieving superhuman performance with DeepMind's AlphaGo , to reducing the energy required to cool Google's Data Centers by 40%, we deeply understand AI and how to apply it in production for massive impact. Phaidra’s ability to achieve its mission is determined by our ability to work together — as defined by our core values: Transparency , Collaboration , Operational Excellence , Ownership , and Empathy. We seek individuals who embody these values, as they are instrumental in ensuring our team consistently delivers excellence and fosters an engaging and supportive culture Phaidra is based in the USA, but we are 100% remote with no physical office. We hire employees internationally with the help of our partner, OysterHR . Our team is currently located throughout the USA, Canada, UK, Sweden, Spain, Portugal, the Netherlands, Singapore, Australia, and India. Who You Are Research Scientists at Phaidra lead our efforts in developing novel algorithmic architecture towards the end goal of bringing intelligent control systems to industrial sector. Having pioneered research in the world's leading academic and industrial labs as PhDs, post-docs or professors, Research Scientists join Phaidra to work collaboratively within and across research fields. Drawing on expertise from a variety of disciplines including model-based reinforcement learning, planning and optimal control, deep learning, world models, and safe reinforcement learning, our Research Scientists are at the forefront of groundbreaking research and applying it to real-world industrial control systems. Responsibilities Design, implement, and evaluate model-based reinforcement learning agents — including planning-based controllers (MPC, MPPI) — and the software prototypes needed to deploy them on real industrial control systems. Develop learned dynamics and world models (learned surrogates) that generalize across systems, including the training pipelines — pretraining, curriculum learning, active/adversarial learning, and fine-tuning — needed to make them reliable for planning and control. Research and implement methods for e.g. safe RL, constrained control, scenario planning and Bayesian RL, to develop agents that satisfy safety constraints during deployment. jobs.title: Face Deduplication Collection
jobs.description: The objective of this project is to collect a large and diverse dataset of current neutral selfies, head-pose captures, and historical facial images to support machine-learning research and facial recognition model training at TELUS. The focus is on capturing real-world variation across lighting, poses, expressions, accessories, environments, and aging to improve model accuracy and robustness. The collection includes: • Current Neutral Selfies – clean frontal selfies serving as high-quality identity references, with natural variation in appearance and surroundings. • Current Head-Pose Captures – selfies captured in assigned head directions to introduce pose variation. • Historical Images – older photos from participants’ galleries to capture natural aging and long-term appearance changes. The objective of this project is to collect a large and diverse dataset of current neutral selfies, head-pose captures, and historical facial images to support machine-learning research and facial recognition model training at TELUS. To qualify for payment, you must submit a minimum of 20 valid images. The maximum payout is based on 24 accepted images. Due to the strict automated and manual Quality Control (QC) process, we strongly recommend submitting 30 images to help ensure that enough images remain valid after review Note: Please use a Gmail address as your primary account when applying for this project. Qualification path No specific education is needed to perform the project task.

jobs.description: Cloudasta is looking for a full-time seasoned Customer Success Lead to own, grow, and protect the commercial relationships within our high-touch customer base. You will be the person our highest-value clients — Directors, VPs, Procurement leads, and C-Suite executives — trust as a strategic partner. Your primary mandate is ensuring clients renew, expand, and view Cloudasta as an indispensable part of their Google ecosystem. Alongside that, you will be expected to drive Gemini and Google Cloud adoption, execute on expansion opportunities, and develop the playbooks that scale our CS motion across the organization. This role is distinct from a traditional Customer Success Manager or Key Account Manager. You will carry a full-cycle commercial motion — onboarding, retention, and upsell — while simultaneously building the systems, segmentation, and coaching cadence that allow your Solutions team to handle the tactical, low-touch layer. Your Responsibilities Account Management & Retention Own a BoB of up to 50 accounts (high-touch), representing ~$4M in total annual Google Workspace spend. Drive contract renewals end-to-end, including multi-year Google Workspace agreements and Google product expansions. Develop and maintain executive relationships at the Director, VP, and C-Suite level across your accounts. Segment your portfolio by churn risk, growth potential, and strategic value — adjusting your cadence accordingly. Maintain a target Net Revenue Retention (NRR) of ≥110% and < 8% churn rate annually across your BoB. Growth & Expansion Identify and execute upsell and cross-sell opportunities including Gemini Enterprise, additional Google Workspace SKUs, and Google Cloud services. Lead a Solutions team and collaborate with Sales to develop account expansion plans tied to QBRs and annual reviews. Actively position Gemini AI features and Google Cloud capabilities during client engagements as part of Cloudasta's value proposition. Onboarding & Product Adoption Lead high-touch onboarding experiences for new and migrated clients, ensuring rapid time-to-value. Drive product adoption across Google Workspace, monitoring usage signals to intervene proactively with at-risk accounts. Build educational materials, training sessions, and adoption playbooks for Gemini and Workspace best practices. Team Leadership After a 90-day onboarding period, take ownership of the Solutions team, with direct reports transitioning to you. Coach and delegate tactical/low-touch account management to your Solutions team, freeing your capacity for strategic high-touch work. Establish clear KPIs, SLAs, and workflows for the combined CS + Solutions Success motion. Operations & Tooling Maintain a clean, up-to-date CRM pipeline across all accounts and contacts in your BoB. Report on key CS metrics weekly and prepare executive summaries for leadership reviews. Partner with the Director of Operations to refine CS SOPs, health scoring models, and renewal workflows. You think commercially. You understand the difference between a support interaction and a revenue conversation, and you know how to navigate both. You are organized and process-driven. Since 2008, our international team has delivered bold, forward-thinking solutions for globally recognised clients. Whether we're building innovative products, producing high-impact social content, or designing smarter ways for our partners to work—we’re right at the cutting edge of creativity, technology, and automation. Embracing Future-Facing Technology Emerging technologies like Artificial Intelligence present exciting opportunities for us and our clients. As the world adapts, we’re committed to safely exploring the potential advantages of AI, integrating it thoughtfully into our work where possible, and one day guiding our clients through new possibilities when they’re open and ready for them. By tapping into our creativity, expertise, and collaboration, we aim to embrace its potential together. Our vision relies on people who are curious about this technology and excited to take on this challenge! About The Role We are hiring an account manager to own the client operating rhythm around Storm Ideas' Creative Operations and Systems / Process Design work. This is a high-accountability client relationship role. You will be responsible for keeping client context, stakeholder needs, open questions, risks, follow-ups, and next steps clear across work that is often messy, fast-moving, and operationally complex. The role exists because this kind of client work fails when account knowledge lives in scattered notes, private conversations, vague update loops, or one person's head. Your job is to turn that into a clear operating rhythm that clients trust and internal teams can actually use. You will not personally build every system. You will be expected to understand the client problem, ask sharper questions, spot weak scope, maintain account context, prepare for the right conversations, and make sure Storm is solving the right thing in the right order. AI is not an optional productivity trick in this role. You should be actively trying to become excellent at using AI tools, reusable workflows, and account-context systems to prepare better, move faster, remember more, and give clients a sharper experience. This is also a relationship role in the real sense. Clients should like working with you. They should feel you understand them, enjoy the conversation, trust your follow-up, and want you involved when things are unclear. If you are looking for a relationship-only account role where someone else owns the operational detail, this is not it. If you are looking for a pure project management or builder role with limited client responsibility, this is not it either. RESPONSIBILITIES What can you expect? Own the account context for selected Creative Operations and Systems / Process Design clients: stakeholders, priorities, history, open questions, risks, decisions, and follow-ups. Run the client operating rhythm so meetings, updates, actions, blockers, decisions, and handoffs do not drift or depend on memory. Turn vague client requests into clear next steps, questions, owners, dependencies, and decision points. Become highly capable with AI tools and workflows for account management: meeting preparation, account research, stakeholder mapping, summarisation, action tracking, client-ready drafting, QA, and reusable account memory. Use AI to make your client work sharper, not just faster. The standard is better context, better questions, better follow-up, and few

jobs.title: AI Operations Manager
jobs.description: 🇪🇬 Up to EUR 25,000 per year, on a full-time, permanent employment contract 🌎 Fully remote working from anywhere in Egypt! 🏖️ 33 Days Paid Leave and Benefits ✨ Exciting high growth product, relied on by leading global brands, particularly within sports 💻 Working with the latest hardware, AI tools, and product workflows. About the Role We are hiring an AI Operations Manager to help drive the operational quality, reliability, and effectiveness of Storyteller’s AI tooling. This role sits within our AI Operations function and is focused on making sure the AI tools, platforms, workflows, and configurations used across the business are well-run, dependable, and continuously improving. AI is moving quickly, and Storyteller is moving with it. We need someone who can stay close to what is changing in the AI tooling landscape, understand what matters for our business, and help turn that understanding into practical operational improvements. A big part of this role is making sure AI tooling is configured properly, used effectively, and operating reliably. You will work with teams who use AI tools day to day, understand where tooling is creating friction, identify what needs to change, and follow through on the detailed operational work that makes systems dependable. This is a high-ownership role for someone who wants real responsibility for how AI tooling operates inside a fast-moving SaaS business. You will bring structure to messy tooling environments, improve visibility, support better standards, and help keep Storyteller in control of fast-changing AI platforms rather than reacting too late. This is not a passive maintenance role. It is for someone who likes improving systems, raising standards, and making AI tooling genuinely work better. About Storyteller Storyteller is a SaaS platform used by globally recognised brands across sport, media, entertainment, and beyond. Our platform helps companies create and deliver engaging story-style content experiences across their digital products. We work with high-profile clients, fast-moving teams, and products that are used by large audiences around the world. We are remote-first, product-led, and highly focused on execution. We care about clear communication, strong ownership, thoughtful use of technology, and building better ways of working as we grow. AI is already an important part of how our teams operate. The AI Operations function exists to make sure our AI tooling is reliable, well-configured, secure, useful, and continuously improving. This role is central to that work. What You Will Do Take operational ownership of the configuration, reliability, and standards of Storyteller’s AI tools and AI platforms. Support the AI Operations team’s response when AI tools, platforms, models, or underlying capabilities change. Set, maintain, and improve operational standards for how AI tooling is configured, accessed, used, and monitored. Improve visibility around AI tool configuration, platform usage, access administration, permissions, dependencies, and operational performance. Identify weak, unstable, or high-friction areas in our AI tooling setup and help develop practical solutions that are durable and scalable. Work with internal teams to understand where AI tooling is helping, where it is creating friction, and what needs to improve. Give leadership clearer visibility on where the AI tooling stack is performing well, where it is fragile, and what platform or workflow changes are needed next. Help ensure Storyteller’s AI tooling remains useful, controlled, reliable, and aligned with how the business actually works. What We Are Looking For Demonstrable experience managing or improving technical platforms, ideally including AI tools, automation platforms, LLM-based tools, or AI-enabled workflows. High agency and strong ownership of operational outcomes. Strong technical judgment, especially around AI tools, platform configuration, workflows, permissions, integrations, APIs, and dependencies.

jobs.description: neoBIM is a cutting‑edge startup transforming the construction industry with AI‑powered Building Information Modeling (BIM). Co‑founded by industry pioneers, the company is on a mission to make BIM smarter, faster and more collaborative. With a growing team, neoBIM offers an innovative work environment, a flexible culture and the chance to work on impactful global projects. We're hiring our founding designer to own the look, feel, and design system of the product from day one — and to do it in a way that's collapsing the old design-to-handoff pipeline. How we think about design here The traditional loop is: design in Figma → hand off → engineers translate to code → drift sets in → repeat. We don't want that. Tools like Claude now let designers express intent directly in code, working in the real design system instead of a mirror of it. So the only translation step left is designer-code → production-code — far closer, far less lossy. We're not dogmatic about never opening a canvas to think. But the designer we want is someone who reaches for code as their primary medium and treats the running product as the source of truth. Tasks Define and build our design system in code, using shadcn/ui as the foundation — tokens, variants, modes, responsive behaviour, accessibility Prototype directly in code with AI assistance (Claude), so what you "design" is already buildable and lives in the codebase Design the entire product surface — from the 3D canvas and viewport controls to property panels, dashboards, and onboarding flows Own iconography and illustration: either craft our icon set and product illustrations yourself, or art-direct freelancers to deliver a consistent, high-quality visual language Work in a tight loop with engineers, where "handoff" mostly means a code review, not a translation Shape the brand and marketing surface as the company grows Requirements This role is for a designer who thinks in systems, understands software constraints, and can reason about 3D interaction — so what you ship is buildable, native to the medium, and not just pretty in a mockup. Specifically: You work in code (HTML/CSS/React) and are comfortable using tools like Claude or similar tools to turn ideas into a working UI. You don't need to be an engineer, but the terminal and a component file don't scare you You have experience designing for 3D, spatial, or canvas-based software — a tool you've shipped, a serious side project, or deep experience using Blender, Rhino, SketchUp, Cinema 4D, Spline, or a game engine. You understand viewport controls, gizmos, camera behaviour, and the seam between 2D UI and a live 3D scene You've designed with shadcn/ui and understand how its tokens, variants, and primitives compose You have a strong icon and illustration eye — you can either produce this work or direct freelancers to a consistent result, and you know what good looks like You design with light/dark mode and responsiveness from the start, not as an afterthought Benefits Founding-level ownership of design at a well-backed startup with a credible founding team in the AEC/3D space Competitive salary Direct access to the founders, no design-by-committee, no layers between you and the work The chance to define how a category of professional 3D tooling looks and feels for the next decade Access to World-Class Infrastructure A Culture of Deep Tech and Real-World Application Flexibility with remote first work enviroment and a great team that shapes the future Send us your portfolio and CV For any questions regarding this position, feel free to contact Felix directly via phone or messenger at +49 176 95422094.
